newsitem.title: GERMANY: ProSieben shares quoted at 77 to 87 dmk.
newsitem.headline: ProSieben shares quoted at 77 to 87 dmk.

text.p: Shares in German television network Pro Sieben AG were quoted at a bid price of 77 marks and ask price 87 marks in their first bourse quotation.
The quotes were below what some analysts had expected, but are in line with the offering price of 72 marks set on Saturday.
ProSieben, whose offering was 50 times oversubscribed, is the first German television broadcaster to list its shares on the stock market.
The issue will raise 1.26 billion marks for the company, and increase its capital by 360 million marks to over 700 million marks.
The share had been trading at prices of up to 120 marks in the grey market.
